items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: And this is John Cole the Ring.

ctx.x: One block from All Ines. One block from All Ines. When you get to All Ines, the next street is Lafitte. Yeah. But that was once the old basin. Yeah. You see, it was a body of water. Yeah. That ran all the way from Canal Street into a towing. Ah. And went all the way out to Byas and John. Yeah. Nice poich. Nice green trout. Everything was right in the water. Like I tell you, just leave your house and go right in the corner. Eh? Ain't got nothing, no. No, no. Sure not. Like I'm telling you, you know. See, now these…
